situation.whoThisIs: Grom Digital, a UK marketing agency selling done-for-you patient acquisition to aesthetic and cosmetic clinics. Founder-led sales calls.
situation.howLeadsArrive: Meta (Facebook and Instagram) lead-form ads. The lead never visits a website first, so the email address is pre-filled from their Facebook profile and is often a secondary or dormant inbox.
situation.whatIsSold: The Pilot Program: free for 30 days, the client pays on results. A signed client is TRIALING before any money moves, and there is no upfront fee to object to.
situation.theFunnel: enquiry -> conversation -> booked Clinic Growth Strategy Session with a founder -> attended -> signed agreement -> 30-day trial -> paying
situation.objective: Engagement, booking, attendance AND conversion, judged on money earned. In the owner's words: we want people to be engaged, but not only engage, convert as well.
knownDataCaveats: This pipeline marks an opportunity `won` ONLY once the client PAYS. There is no stage for closed-and-trialing, so signed clients sit in `open` indefinitely. A zero win count NEVER means nothing closed, and `showed_to_decision` reading zero is the same artefact.

After a client signs, the work of onboarding them happens in a separate portal, not in this system. So eleven of the journey steps this system declares, everything from the internal handoff onward, will always read as unmeasurable here. That is not a gap in the account and it is not a finding: the events simply happen somewhere else.
Nothing records the moment a lead becomes qualified, so `contacted_to_qualified` and `qualified_to_strategy_call` have no signal at all.

This system is DESIGNED to handle leads with automation and AI, and its AI books more appointments than any other route. Inserting a human is not a generic fix here and must be argued from the evidence if argued at all.

The Voice AI agent named VOKI, business name Voksica, is a TEST agent and is not part of this business. Owner confirmed 2026-07-28. Its script, its Make.com webhook actions and its physiotherapy framing are all deliberate scratch work, so none of that is a finding. What WOULD be a finding is VOKI having inbound calling switched on, or a workflow or calendar routing real contacts to it: check isInboundActive before dismissing anything about it.

Owner confirmed 2026-07-28 that Hana, the onboarding AI assistant in Grom's separate client portal, was intended to send clients a daily onboarding update. The 2026-07-29 GHL reread subsequently observed the published, client-facing send path UK GROM Daily Update - Hana: an inbound webhook sends to {{inboundWebhookRequest.email}} from Hana, while the subject and main body are supplied through portal merge fields. Keep the evidence boundary exact. Portal conversations and the values rendered by the portal are outside this audit unless portal evidence is added, and the actual portal-supplied subject and body cannot be judged from GHL alone. The GHL workflow itself is IN SCOPE: its trigger, recipients, runtime, fixed wrapper copy, fallback behavior, and interaction with the other onboarding communications must all be reviewed. This is not the GoHighLevel Courses feature, and Hana's existence must never suppress a finding about this workflow or the delivery copy around it.

AN APPOINTMENT OUTCOME CANNOT BE AUTOMATED. Owner confirmed 2026-07-28: whether a meeting was attended or missed is set by the person who was IN the meeting, an executive, by hand. So do not propose a workflow that writes it. The honest fix for the 22 unresolved appointments is an internal notification asking that person to close them out, and the finding that the outcome is unrecorded remains true and important because every attendance number depends on it.

SENDING THE CONTRACT IS A DELIBERATE HUMAN DECISION. Owner confirmed 2026-07-28: an executive runs the strategy call, qualifies the client on the call, and sends the contract only if they agree. There is no automated path from a call to a contract and there should not be one, so an apparent gap between the strategy stage and the contract stage is the process working.

07 Send Contract and 07.5 Contract Signed share a trigger TYPE and not a trigger. Owner confirmed 2026-07-28: 07 fires when the document is SENT, 07.5 when it is SIGNED or accepted. Any claim that these two race, or that a signed client is chased for a signature, must be argued from the trigger FILTERS on each workflow and never from the shared type alone.

PLANNED, NOT BUILT: a reactivation sequence for leads who finish the nurture ladder without booking. Owner confirmed 2026-07-28. So the absence of anything after the ladder ends is known and being worked on, and recommending that it exist adds nothing.

AN OPPORTUNITY WITH NO MONETARY VALUE IS NOT AN OVERSIGHT. Owner confirmed 2026-07-28: every client gets a custom offer priced after the trial ends, so a value cannot honestly be set at the point the opportunity is created. It still means revenue is UNMEASURABLE rather than zero, and a per-client figure entered once the offer is agreed would fix that.

targets.basis: This system contacts every enquiry by automation, so anything short of near-total coverage is a delivery or enrolment failure rather than a sales result. Speed matters more than coverage here: published data puts close rates at 32% when the first reply lands inside five minutes against 12% at 24 hours, and the average business takes 42 hours.

Normal band for a FREE B2B discovery call is 50 to 70 percent, and 65 is the middle of it. Owner chose normal deliberately on 2026-07-28. The same research puts a paid or deposit-backed call at 85 percent, so raising this target is a product decision about charging for the call, not a marketing one.

About 35 percent of shown high-ticket B2B discovery calls close, and first-meeting-to-opportunity runs 30 to 50 percent where discovery is sharp. Read this against the caveat that this pipeline only marks won once the client PAYS.
